scanner_error.cause: OpenAI explicit tools list contains a custom tool-factory call use_gateway_tool(...), which the adapter currently drops because it is not a recognized built-in/tool wrapper.

evidence.fact: Spark Assistant explicitly supplies a tools list.
The list contains use_gateway_tool("http_echo", ...), proving a tool-factory binding with literal gateway tool identity.
use_gateway_tool is a helper factory, not the produced tool itself.
gateway_tool decorates a generated _gateway_tool with OpenAI Agents function_tool.
The generated wrapper name is set to gateway_{tool_name}.

rationale: The locked reference names the factory helper use_gateway_tool as the authority target, but pinned source proves that helper returns a generated OpenAI function tool backed by literal gateway tool http_echo. Exact runtime naming cannot be established from this repository alone without relying on OpenAI Agents decorator behavior, so the corrected target remains unresolved. HorusTrace still has a real recall gap because it drops this explicit custom factory binding; a generalized factory rule should require evidence beyond this single case.
